title: NDP Neighbor Solicitation (ICMPv6 type 135)
summary: NDP Neighbor Solicitation is ICMPv6 type 135. It resolves an IPv6 address to a MAC address (replacing ARP). Format: type (135), code (0), checksum (2), reserved (4), target address (16 bytes), then options (source link-layer address, etc.).

ext.summary: NDP Neighbor Solicitation is ICMPv6 type 135. It resolves an IPv6 address to a MAC address (replacing ARP). Format: type (135), code (0), checksum (2), reserved (4), target address (16 bytes), then options (source link-layer address, etc.).
notes: NDP NS is the IPv6 equivalent of ARP request.
The target address is the IPv6 address being resolved.
Source link-layer address option carries the sender's MAC.
NS is sent to the solicited-node multicast address (ff02::1:ff00:0/104 + last 24 bits of target).
